description: Lokalizacja pojazdów Tramwajów Warszawskich is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Urząd m.st. Warszawy_. Zawiera dane o lokalizacji geograficznej tramwajów realizujących przewozy pasażerów. Dostęp do zbioru wymaga rejestracji na stronie Warunki korzystania z danych są dostępne na stronie. Coverage: Urząd m.st. Warszawy_. The publisher named on the listing is Urząd m.st. Warszawy_. Its keywords include on-line, tramwaj, Warszawa, api. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, RDF. The listing shows 2024-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
